segments.name: Renewable Natural Gas
segments.description: Produces renewable natural gas from landfill and livestock farm biogas and sells the gas and its environmental attributes to off-take counterparties.
segments.evidence: We record revenues from the production and sale of RNG and the generation and sale of the Environmental Attributes derived from RNG, such as RINs and LCFS credits.

segments.name: Renewable Electricity Generation
segments.description: Generates electricity at biogas-to-electricity plants and sells the power and related environmental attributes under long-term fixed-price contracts.
segments.evidence: We record revenues from the production and sale of Renewable Electricity and the generation and sale of the Environmental Attributes, such as RECs, derived from Renewable Electricity.

revenueModel.text: Utilities and fuel off-take counterparties pay for RNG, Renewable Electricity and the Environmental Attributes generated from them under off-take agreements, PPAs and fixed-price contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Renewable Natural Gas and Renewable Electricity Generation segments' revenues are primarily driven by the prices under our off-take agreements and PPAs and the amount of RNG and Renewable Electricity that we produce.
